title: SEBI Fines Merchant Banker Swastika Investmart Rs 10 Lakh Over SME IPO Due Diligence Lapses
court: Securities and Exchange Board of India
case_name: Adjudication proceedings against Swastika Investmart Limited (merchant banker)
citation: SEBI adjudication order, Adjudicating Officer Amit Kapoor, dated 4 November 2026
card_summary: SEBI's adjudicating officer fined merchant banker Swastika Investmart Rs 10 lakh for due diligence lapses on two SME IPOs, Aditya Ultra Steel and Resourceful Automobile. The order found gaps in verifying directors' qualifications and work experience, and in disclosures on issue expenses. The officer held that a registered intermediary's statutory duty stands regardless of corrective steps taken later.
card_tip: A merchant banker on an SME IPO must independently verify promoter and KMP credentials and expense disclosures, not take the issuer's word for it; fixing the process later will not undo liability for lapses already made.
